subject: the-red-oath
q: POST-RITUAL and PRESSURE-RITUAL are both named, neither is defined, and the difference is practical enough to change where people sit.
detail:
VIRAENA ASKED CYRENA DIRECTLY, WALKING INTO THE KITCHEN: POST RITUAL OR PRESSURE RITUAL, CERI? SINCE THAT WILL CHANGE WHERE WE SIT.

WHICH TELLS THE ARCHIVE THREE THINGS AND NO MORE.
ONE: THERE ARE AT LEAST TWO NAMED STATES, and a member of this household can tell which one is in effect by asking a single question.
TWO: THE DIFFERENCE IS SPATIAL AND PRACTICAL. It governs SEATING, in a shared kitchen, which means it affects the room rather than only the two of them.
THREE: NOBODY NEEDED IT EXPLAINED. The question was asked casually and expected a one-word answer, so the distinction is ORDINARY HOUSEHOLD KNOWLEDGE here.

WHAT THE ARCHIVE WILL NOT DO IS GUESS AT THE MECHANICS. PRESSURE suggests a before or a building, and POST suggests an after, AND THAT IS PATTERN-MATCHING ON TWO ENGLISH WORDS. It does not know whether pressure-ritual is a phase of the act, a state Cyrena is in, a state Destiny is in, a condition of the room, or something about the marks. IT DOES NOT KNOW WHY EITHER ONE MOVES A CHAIR.

AND THIS IS EXACTLY THE CLASS OF THING THE ARCHIVE GOT WRONG TODAY BY GUESSING FORWARD FROM A WORD. SWAY looked like a menu value and was a Shape-native expression. LEANING MORE LEG looked like a ratio and was an emphasis inside a balanced frame. PRESSURE AND POST LOOK LIKE A BEFORE AND AN AFTER. They are two words in a kitchen and nothing more until somebody says otherwise.

ONE QUESTION: WHAT ARE THE TWO PHASES, AND WHY DOES ONE OF THEM MOVE THE SEATING.
